newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures lukewarm to U.S.-Iraq news.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures lukewarm to U.S.-Iraq news.

text.p: Yen-based gold futures attracted only a lukewarm response on Tuesday to news that the United States had launched cruise missiles against Iraq, ending marginally firmer in response to the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Dollar-based spot gold prices rose slighly after news of the missile launches, traders said.
Gold futures ranged from two to six yen per gram higher with benchmark August finishing three yen firmer at 1,349 yen.
Spot gold was slightly higher at $387.30/70 per ounce at 0739 GMT, against $386.65/387.15 in London on Monday.
